name: testa-platform
description: Testa frontend tracker + edge worker + event collector

scripts.diagrams: for f in docs/architecture/diagrams/*.mmd; do npx -y -p @mermaid-js/mermaid-cli@12.0.0 mmdc -q -i "$f" -o "${f%.mmd}.png" -b white --size 2400 && npx -y -p @mermaid-js/mermaid-cli@12.0.0 mmdc -q -i "$f" -o "${f%.mmd}.svg" -b transparent || exit 1; done
